bookingOpens: Online on SevenRooms through the restaurant's website, or by phone or email (booking@alajmo.it).
cancellation: Cancel or change the number of guests at least 24 hours ahead. After that, and for no-shows or fewer guests than booked, €150 a person is charged. A card is taken when booking. A table may not be held after 30 minutes' delay without notice.
dressCode: No dress code, but no shorts or flip-flops.
children: Children are welcome. Guests with children under 8 are seated in the private room when it is free. There are no high chairs.
